- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1793 | HARDENING_SUGGESTION (advisory, not a finding) | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
  PROBLEM: `printf 'hit %s\n' "${kind}" >> "${stats}" 2>/dev/null || true` (the miss-counter line a few lines below has the same shape). Bash opens the `>>` target before it applies `2>/dev/null`, so if the stats file cannot be opened, the open error reaches the caller's stderr.
  WHY: This is the pattern the last run fixed on line 1795. This line predates the PR (#9928), and a failed write only loses a statistic. Suggested fix: `{ printf 'hit %s\n' "${kind}" >> "${stats}"; } 2>/dev/null || true`, and the same for the miss line. Estimated lines changed: 2.
